name: dancehalf_fixed_straight（半分・指固定）
description: 腕の動き50%・右ID8=4608、ID9=3210、左ID18=3053で指固定。ユーザー報告の現在値を使用。腕の実機対応は未検証。

generation.method: Vision2D two-view direction estimation + constrained IK; uncalibrated cameras; hand orientation interpreted from visible gesture, not measured 3D hand tracking
generation.reviewStatus: Awaiting CAD visual check of pointing revision
generation.pointingRevision: Visual review of both videos: both arms extend diagonally forward/up at6–8s; right continues higher at9–10s. Direction from shoulder-to-wrist, elbow extension explicit. Finger shape not reproduced.
generation.preparationRevision: Source4.85–6.1s: independent C2 elbow pull-back and wrist droop/recovery. Wrist direction approximated from two camera images, not measured angles.

provisionalPointingFingers.status: legacy values explicitly requested by user; replace when updated calibration is supplied

handTracking.method: MediaPipe Hand Landmarker, two pose-guided hand crops per view, palm/long-axis IK
handTracking.reviewStatus: Overlays visually checked at source5.37 and6.97s; CAD checked both sides separately at7s, preparation5.4s andright9s. Full-frame numerical bounds checked. Not exact full-sequence reproduction; see mediapipe-report.json for unresolved errors.

wristTurn.method: Preserve chronological lateral-view hand orientations during4.35–6.5s; front fallback; 3axis IK; no imposed full360turn

beckoningFingers.method: MediaPipe median PIP flexion, two-view confidence filtering, temporal median/Gaussian smoothing, provisional coupled tendon mapping

smoothingProtection.label: 指差し前の手首の回転

retargeting.fingerStatus: Provisional source finger counts retained unchanged, not a calibrated endpoint mapping. User plans tendon calibration.

amplitudeEdit.method: rest + 0.5 * (original count - rest), rounded to integer
amplitudeEdit.fingerCalibration: provisional; half encoder excursion, not half finger bend
